sources.title: 2024 UK PRTR dataset
sources.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
sources.verified_fact: The official publication lists the 2024 UK PRTR reporting-year dataset as a 14 MB XML resource for industrial emissions and waste transfers.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an exact machine-readable facility-reporting resource; thresholds and measured/calculated/estimated method codes remain required during parsing.

sources.title: 2024 Pollution Inventory Dataset.zip
sources.surface: Official Defra Data Services download resource
sources.verified_fact: The National Data Library and Defra Data Services Platform list the 2024 Pollution Inventory ZIP for annual releases from large regulated English industrial sites.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an exact England facility-release resource while preserving the Environment Agency Conditional Licence and one-year permitted-use limitation.

sources.title: UK ETS Compliance Report - emissions and surrenders
sources.surface: Official public registry Excel report listing
sources.verified_fact: The registry lists a compliance report covering emissions and UK allowances surrendered by relevant installation and aircraft accounts for scheme years 2021 to 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds verified-compliance emissions reconciliation; registry account records do not by themselves provide parcel geometry.

sources.title: NAEIPointsSources_2023.xlsx
sources.verified_fact: NAEI lists the 2023 point-source workbook and states that point sources are known-location sources with grid references that can be mapped directly.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a large coordinate-bearing facility resource while retaining the residual area-source limitation where individual installations do not represent the full sector total.

sources.title: UK ETS hospital and small emitters emissions and targets data 2021-2025
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.verified_fact: The workbook contains participating installation names, regulators, annual targets and actual annual emissions from 2021 through 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an exact lower-emitter installation resource suitable for future identity and value crosschecks.

sources.title: UK ETS Allocation Table 2021-2026
sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.surface: Official direct installation allocation Excel resource
sources.verified_fact: The official workbook lists installation free allocations for 2021 to 2026 and records activity-level-change amendments.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an exact installation identity and allocation resource; free allowance quantity is explicitly not treated as measured emissions.
